text: In this video we'll see how to use the Drevi wholesale portal, step by step.
caption: How to use the Drevi portal

text: Open the message you got on WhatsApp, and tap the link in it.
caption: Tap the link in your WhatsApp message

text: Type the login name exactly as it is written in the message. Do not use your own Gmail.
caption: Type the username from the message

text: Next, type the password that is given in the message.
caption: Now type the password

text: Now tap Sign In.
caption: Tap Sign In

text: This is your home screen. New designs and all the categories are right here.
caption: Home screen: new designs and categories

text: The three lines at the top left are the menu. Catalog, Cart and My Orders are all in there.
caption: Menu is the three lines top left

text: Tap Catalog.
caption: Tap Catalog

text: Every design is here, with its photo, name, SKU and wholesale price.
caption: Every design with photo, SKU and price

text: To narrow the list, pick a category at the top, like Lehenga.
caption: Pick a category, like Lehenga

text: You can also search by name or SKU.
caption: Or search by name or SKU

text: Tap any design's photo to open it.
caption: Tap a photo to open the design

text: All the details are here. The fabric, the work on it, and the price.
caption: Fabric, work and price details

text: The quantity is below. Tap plus to add pieces.
caption: Tap plus to add pieces

text: Now tap Add to Cart.
caption: Tap Add to Cart

text: Tap the cart icon at the top right.
caption: Tap the cart icon top right

text: You can change the quantity here too. The total updates on its own.
caption: Change quantity, total updates itself

text: To remove an item, tap the cross.
caption: Tap the cross to remove an item

text: Below, you can write a note, anything you want to tell Rakesh about this order.
caption: Add a note for Rakesh below

text: Then tap Submit Order Request. No payment happens here.
caption: Submit Order Request, no payment now

text: Your request has reached us. Rakesh will call within 24 hours to confirm stock and rate.
caption: Request received, Rakesh calls in 24 hours

text: All your orders and bills are in My Orders.
caption: Orders and bills in My Orders

text: One more thing. If you ever forget your password, tap Forgot Password on the login page.
caption: Forgot your password? Tap here

text: Type your username and tap Message Rakesh on WhatsApp. He will send you a new password.
caption: Message Rakesh for a new password

text: Any question at all, just reply on WhatsApp. Thank you.
caption: Any question? Just reply on WhatsApp
